children: China firmly opposes the US Federal ​Communications Commission's vote ‌to ban Chinese telecommunications firms from direct ​access to US phone numbers, its commerce ministry said on Sunday.
Thursday's FCC decision, which cited national security concerns, will bar China Mobile
and other IP-enabled service providers from direct access.

The regulator has pushed for decoupling the US and China in the telecoms, communications, and testing and certification sectors, the Chinese ministry said in a statement, adding the actions run counter to the consensus reached by the countries' leaders.
China urged the United States to retract the ban, warning it would take necessary counter measures.
